Description: Right-angle 2x15 header on the bottom edge (the slot pinout, docs/hardware/accessory_ports.md). Used: 5 V, GND, CAN, switched 12 V (8), constant 12 V (10), WAKE (12). Not used: the slot 3.3 V (the card makes its own), slot ID (the node is fixed), LAMP, REV, I2S, audio, AUX 12 V
Notes: Same part as the audio and GPS cards; on the bottom edge, pins pointing off the board

Description: Senders: 1 FUEL, 2 FUEL return, 3 ETEMP, 4 ETEMP V (5 V, 0.1 A PTC), 5 ETEMP return, 6 OILP, 7 OILP V (5 V, 0.1 A PTC), 8 OILP return, 9 AMB, 10 AMB return, 11 ALT L (alternator lamp terminal, 12 V level), 12 GND
Speed sensor: 1 sensor power (5 V or 12 V by JP1, 0.1 A PTC), 2 signal, 3 GND, 4 GND / shield
Tach: 1 coil negative / HEI tach terminal / ignition box tach output, 2 GND
RPM select jumpers (pulses per revolution; internal pull-ups): 1-2 = A, 3-4 = B
SWD: 1 3V3 (target-voltage sense, not a supply: power the card from its slot), 2 SWDIO, 3 SWCLK, 4 NRST, 5 GND. As the GPS and radio cards
FTDI 6-pin pinout, 3.3 V logic (USART1): 1 GND, 2 CTS (grounded), 3 VCC (not used: power from the slot), 4 adapter TX (into the card), 5 adapter RX (out of the card), 6 DTR (not used)
Sensor serial (USART2, 115200 8N1): 1 GND, 2 TX at 5 V (sensor frames out: jumper wire to the main board J27 pin 1), 3 RX in (3.3 V logic, 5 V tolerant through 1k; the center's keepalive)
Speed sensor supply: 1-2 (bridged as delivered) = 5 V; cut 1-2 and bridge 2-3 = slot switched 12 V
